FN-SY3M58-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 59
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Rodger Smitherman
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/03/2023
Senate Bill 59 as introduced prohibits public agencies from collecting and disclosing certain
personal information about members, volunteers and donors of nonprofit organizations, except
as required by law. This could increase the financial obligations of state and local public
agencies, including but not limited to public institutions of higher education by undetermined
amounts dependent upon the number of violations committed by such agencies and the amount
of damages awarded by the courts.
This bill could also increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds
from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and
the penalties imposed.
